title: Structure is in the zoom: probing neural symmetry through dimensionality scaling
abstract: arXiv:2611.08506v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: How much of a neural population's measured dimensionality is the code, and how much is the act of measuring it? The slope of the participation ratio against subsample size is reported for cortical populations and for the layers of language models as a number that belongs to the system. It does not. One patch of eleven thousand mouse V1 neurons returns three slopes, 0.25 along random stimulus subsets, 0.31 along drift direction, 0.35 along neuron count, and only the middle one carries structure; the other two are the sampling floor.   We split every exponent into that floor and a shift earned along a declared axis, and read the shift against two nulls: permuting the labels, and permuting them only among samples that share a nuisance. On V1 the direction-aligned shift clears the label null in eight of eight grating recordings, is positive in 32 of 32 animals in a second laboratory, and reads both sectors of the code's O(2) symmetry. translated_title: 结构就在缩放之中：通过维度缩放探测神经对称性
translated_abstract: 神经群体被测得的维度中，有多少属于编码本身，又有多少只是测量行为带来的？参与率随子样本规模变化的斜率，常被当作属于系统本身的数字来报告，涵盖皮层群体以及语言模型的各层。但事实并非如此。一小块包含一万一千个小鼠V1神经元的区域给出三个斜率：沿随机刺激子集为0.25，沿漂移方向为0.31，沿神经元数量为0.35——只有中间那个携带结构，另外两个只是抽样底线。我们将每个指数拆分为该底线和沿某一声明轴获得的偏移量，并对照两个零假设来解读该偏移：打乱标签，以及仅在共享某一混杂因素的样本之间打乱标签。在V1上，与方向对齐的偏移量在全部八条光栅记录中都通过了标签零假设检验，在另一个实验室的32只动物中全部为正，并读取到了编码O(2)对称性的两个扇区。
tldr: 该论文提出将维度缩放指数分解为抽样底线与沿特定轴的结构性偏移，证明该斜率并非神经系统的固有属性，并借此在小鼠V1中检测出神经编码的O(2)对称性。
en_tdlr: The paper decomposes dimensionality-scaling exponents into a sampling floor and a structured shift, showing that such slopes are not intrinsic to a neural system, and uses the shift to reveal the O(2) symmetry of neural codes in mouse V1.
